profile.name: 扫描数据库组件
profile.description: 这是一个用于实验扫描系统的非物理软件组件，提供扫描数据库的主接口。它用于管理扫描定义、命令队列、EPICS PV 列表、位置器、探测器、计数器、额外 PV、扫描数据、消息与状态信息，并支持保存与恢复仪器位置以及根据已保存定义创建扫描对象。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that serves as the main interface to a scan database for laboratory experiments. It manages scan definitions, command queues, EPICS PV lists, positioners, detectors, counters, extra PVs, scan data, messages, and status records, and it also supports saving/restoring instrument positions and creating scan objects from saved definitions.
